verdict.rationale: A government tax service like impots.gouv.fr could plausibly expose versioned programmatic APIs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only web-portal services such as login, payments, forms, e-invoicing info and the tax calendar. It contains nothing about API versioning or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
